_about: Public-domain Frank Wakeley Gunsaulus (1856-1921), Congregational pastor of Central Church, Chicago, and founding president of Armour Institute, for the Word Hoard: his religious books only: November at Eastwood (sermons), The Man of Galilee, Paths to Power, Paths to the City of God, The Transfiguration of Christ, The Minister and the Spiritual Life (Yale lectures), Young Men in History, Martin Luther and the Morning Hour in Europe, a 1912 sermon and his Prayers (1922). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 90 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
